# Gatherup

GatherUp is a customer feedback and online review management platform that helps businesses collect, manage, and leverage customer feedback to improve their online reputation.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gatherup/.

## Actions

- **Delete GatherUp Business**: Delete an existing business location.
- **Generate GatherUp Hash Signature**: Generate a SHA-256 hash signature required by GatherUp endpoints.
- **Get GatherUp Business**: Get business details by business ID.
- **Get GatherUp Business Types**: Get business types.
- **Get GatherUp Customer**: Get customer details by ID.
- **Search GatherUp Business**: Find business ID by customField or extraField.
- **Send GatherUp Customer Feedback**: Send a feedback request to a customer.
